ideas.pitch: An IoT and ML-driven urban monitoring network that predicts localized asthma and respiratory attack risks 24 hours in advance.
ideas.problem_statement: HealthTech Innovation: Develop solutions that can improve medical services, patient care, or health monitoring.
ideas.title: AuraSense: Real-Time IoT Air Quality and Asthma Trigger Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical IoT sensors with predictive machine learning, directly targeting the HealthTech Innovation theme with a clear, measurable public health impact.

ideas.pitch: A localized educational assistant utilizing small language models to translate and simplify complex STEM textbooks into regional Indian languages offline.
ideas.problem_statement: EdTech Revolution: Revolutionize education with technology. Create tools and platforms that enhance the learning experience, making education more accessible and engaging.
ideas.title: EduBridge AI: Offline-First Multilingual RAG for Rural Classrooms
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a profound real-world accessibility problem in Indian education using edge AI, matching the EdTech Revolution theme with high social impact.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computed smart bin sensor and dashboard that dynamically routes municipal garbage collection trucks to minimize fuel burn and overflow.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart Cities and IoT: Innovate for the future of urban living. Build IoT solutions that can make cities smarter, more efficient, and better connected.
ideas.title: SmartBins IoT: Computer Vision and LoRaWAN Waste Route Optimization
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features tangible hardware simulation and operational cost-saving metrics that appeal directly to smart city judges looking for scalable urban infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: A mobile web app that analyzes smartphone photos of soil and crop leaves using computer vision to instantly recommend precise fertilizer mixes and predict harvest yields.
ideas.problem_statement: Agriculture and AgriTech: Explore innovations in farming, crop management, or supply chain efficiency using technology.
ideas.title: NutriCrop AI: Smartphone-Based Soil Nutrient and Crop Yield Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent local economic problem for farmers with a working end-to-end mobile demo and clear agricultural yields benefit.

ideas.pitch: An IoT temperature-monitoring badge paired with a blockchain ledger to ensure vaccines and perishable medicines do not spoil during rural transit.
ideas.problem_statement: HealthTech Innovation: Dive into the world of healthcare and wellness by developing solutions that can improve medical services, patient care, or health monitoring.
ideas.title: MediChain IoT: Cold-Chain Vaccine Integrity and Expiry Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines healthcare safety with verifiable logistics, impressing judges with a life-saving application built on robust hardware-software integration.
